title: Release on a child device
description: Running release: until `until` the rule(s) of kind do not apply on this child device. bedtime: kids_quiet_hours; pause: kids_rate_limit and running pauses; entity: blocked type and bedtime for entity_id (never locks/alarm panels or entities blocked in kids_exceptions). Ends at until (hub planner), by release_end or when the device loses parental controls. At most one release per kind (and per entity).
